name: 5-MeO-IsoqT
summary: 5-MeO-IsoqT, also known as 5-MeO-desethylisoquinuclidineT or as desethyl-17,18-secoibogaine, is a tryptamine derivative and a deconstructed and simplified analogue of ibogaine. It is a derivative of ibogaine lacking the tetrahydroazepine ring but with the isoquinuclidine ring retained.

uses.en: It is a research compound, made to study which parts of the ibogaine molecule matter.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，用來研究伊博格因分子中哪些部分是關鍵。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，用来研究伊博格因分子中哪些部分是关键。

fact.en: It is a stripped-down version of ibogaine, the compound from the West African iboga shrub, with one of ibogaine's rings removed while keeping its distinctive cage-like isoquinuclidine ring.
fact.zh: 它是伊博格因（ibogaine）的簡化版本；伊博格因來自西非的伊博加灌木。這個化合物去掉了伊博格因的其中一個環，但保留了它特有的籠狀異奎寧環結構。
fact.zhHans: 它是伊博格因（ibogaine）的简化版本；伊博格因来自西非的伊博加灌木。这个化合物去掉了伊博格因的其中一个环，但保留了它特有的笼状异奎宁环结构。
